# Coral Travel

> Coral Travel is a leading Russian travel agency offering beach resort bookings and package tours to Egypt, Turkey, Tunisia and other destinations worldwide.

The platform specializes in all-inclusive resort hotels across popular destinations including Hurghada, Sharm El Sheikh, Antalya, Istanbul, and Sousse. Coral Travel features the Coral Family Club program, Coralbonus loyalty rewards, and partnerships with premium hotel chains including Starway World Best Hotels.
